candidates.name: GRS Krutyanskaya-Voivozh Gas Pipeline
aka: Межпоселковый газопровод от ГРС Крутянская до п. Войвож
candidates.sponsor: AO Gazprom gazoraspredelenie Syktyvkar (Gazprom Mezhregiongaz group)
candidates.status_guess: construction or operating (84 of 102 km built by Sep 2022; completion planned 2022; confirm commissioning)

evidence.note: 102 km high-pressure inter-settlement gas pipeline GRS Krutyanskaya to Voivozh, Ukhta and Sosnogorsk districts, Gazprom gazoraspredelenie Syktyvkar, completion planned 2022, 11 settlements
most of the pipeline built (84 of 102 km); Komi gasification programme 2021-2025

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not in roster (P6675 Bratskoye-Bratsk II is a false hint). OSM trace ~125 km; sourced length 102 km >= 25 km. Replaces an emergency Ukhta municipal pipeline. Diameter not found.

seed_ledger.name: МГ "Омск-Новосибирск"
seed_ledger.reason: OSM trace ~99.5 km matches roster P5517 Omsk-Novosibirsk-Kuzbass / Novosibirsk-Kuzbass (99 km, Novosibirsk->Proskokovo CS), operator Novosibirsk LPUMG; P2362 (658 km Omsk->Novosibirsk) is the sibling string. Geometry candidate for P5517 (section of the Omsk-Novosibirsk-Kuzbass trunk), not a new row.

seed_ledger.name: Газопровод-отвод к ГРС-2 Томска
seed_ledger.reason: Earlier d1-d4 merged run vetted tomsk-asino (78 km branch Tomsk-Asino, built 2017-2022, Gazprom); its notes flag this OSM seed (~79.9 km) as probably the same line. P4210 (Vytegra-Pudozh) is a false hint; P6691 Yakutia is unrelated.

seed_ledger.name: Проскоково — Линёво
seed_ledger.reason: Proskokovo (Kemerovo oblast) and Linevo (Novosibirsk oblast) both lie on the Novosibirsk-Proskokovo section of the Omsk-Novosibirsk-Kuzbass trunk (P5517, 99 km, Novosibirsk->Proskokovo CS); 77.3 km trace is a partial/parallel trace of it. P2376 (Proskokovo-Achinsk-Balagansk, cancelled 1600 km) is a name hit only. Searches found no separate project; if a distinct parallel line exists it is a P5517 string (II) for Update.

seed_ledger.name: Нюксеница — Архангельск
seed_ledger.reason: Vetted new_row in d4-northwest and d1-d4 merged (796.9 km incl. Velsk/Plesetsk/Mirny/Severodvinsk/Novodvinsk branches, Gazprom transgaz Ukhta, operating). P5510 is a false hint (Kovykta).

seed_ledger.name: Ленинград — Выборг — Госграница 1
seed_ledger.reason: Roster P2335 (I) and P5590 (II) are Leningrad-Vyborg-State Border, 115 km. The 286 km OSM trace is longer than the roster length (likely merged with adjacent Gryazovets-Vyborg / Leningrad inbound segments; OSM diameter 820 vs roster 1220). Treat as route candidate for P2335; length/diameter discrepancy for Update. P2337 (Magnitogorsk-Sterlitamak) is a false hint.

seed_ledger.name: ГРС Крутянская — Войвож
seed_ledger.reason: 102 km inter-settlement high-pressure gas pipeline GRS Krutyanskaya-Voivozh (Ukhta/Sosnogorsk, Komi), Gazprom gazoraspredelenie Syktyvkar, 84/102 km built Sep 2022, completion planned 2022. Not in roster.

seed_ledger.name: Отвод к ГРС Ломоносов
seed_ledger.reason: No source for a 65.9 km Lomonosov spur found (one search); only a 24.81 km reconstruction project across Lomonosov/Gatchina/Volosovo/Slantsy/Kingisepp districts surfaced, below threshold and not clearly the same pipe. Length unknown/unsourced; OSM trace 377 mm, Gazprom transgaz St Petersburg. P3991 (Vylgort-Pazhga) is a false hint.

seed_ledger.name: Valday - Borovichi
seed_ledger.reason: Real operating Gazprom spur (Valday-Borovichi, plus 'Valday-Borovichi-2' referenced in Novgorod documents; GRS Borovichi at Shibotovo) but no source states its length; 63.8 km is the reference-trace figure only. P6684 (Pelyatka-Messoyakha II) is a false hint. Length unknown: confirm via Gazprom transgaz St Petersburg / Novgorod gas schema before adding.
